# A 100.00 USD invoice booked at 1.40, overpaid with 200.00 USD which the
# customer's bank converted into 274.00 CAD — a rate of 1.37.
#
# Two things are settled at once and they are not settled at the same rate.
# The 100.00 USD that clears the invoice is valued at what the invoice
# carried, 1.40, so 140.00 CAD of cost is consumed with it; the 100.00 USD
# overpaid was received at 1.37, so the credit is worth 137.00 CAD. What the
# bank actually received, 274.00, less those two is the 3.00 CAD the invoice
# lost by being paid at a weaker rate than it was booked at.
#
# What this fixture produces:
#
#   Assets:Bank                     274.00 CAD
#   A/R USD  -100.00 USD   value -140.00 CAD   (settles the invoice)
#   A/R USD  -100.00 USD   value -137.00 CAD   (the credit, at 1.37)
#   Income:FX Gain                    3.00 CAD  ($residual$, a loss)
#
# and no Imbalance split. Valuing the credit at the invoice's 1.40 instead, or
# leaving it out of the arithmetic, put 137.00 CAD into an imbalance and
# reported the loss as 134.00.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_payment_exchange_rate.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-OVERCAD"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-OVERCAD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		settled_amount: 274.00
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-OVERCAD"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
